title: Searching not tracked returns untracked parts plus normal matches
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHA-U1, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH A WASHER) is untracked at {Location-A}, and none of its fields contains "not" or "tracked".
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHA-N1) is tracked at {Location-A}, and its description contains the words NOT TRACKED (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH A NOT TRACKED LABEL).
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRCHA-P1, described ZZAUTOTEST PL SEARCH A PLAIN GASKET) is tracked at {Location-A}, and none of its fields contains either word.
  • Other parts in the environment are also returned by these searches; this case checks only these three.
custom_steps:
1. Type not tracked in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the Part Number column header until it sorts Z to A, so the ZZAUTOTEST rows come first.
  3. Read which of the three parts are listed.
  4. Replace the search text with Not (capital N).
  5. Read which of the three parts are listed.
  6. Replace the search text with TRACKED, typed with two spaces before it and two spaces after it.
  7. Read which of the three parts are listed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-A} is listed (it reads "Not Tracked"), {Part-B} is listed (its description matches) and {Part-C} is not listed.
  • Step 5: The same: {Part-A} and {Part-B} listed, {Part-C} not listed; upper and lower case do not matter.
  • Step 7: The same: {Part-A} and {Part-B} listed, {Part-C} not listed; the spaces before and after do not matter.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S6-R1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.4 (Finding untracked parts) and tracking-note-3, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked", "not" or "tracked" in the Inventory search returns the untracked parts, together with every part those words match on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields. Upper and lower case, and spaces before and after the term, do not matter.”
